PGT121-like broadly neutralizing antibodies recognize complex-type N-gycans on HIV-1 gp120 and exhibit differential binding to high-mannose glycans, and that the ability of PGT121 to recognize complex-type N- glycans is critical for its neutralization of HIV-1.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the HIV-1 envelope glycoprotein (Env) is a complex glycoprotein with a diverse set of glycans that can be recognized by broadly neutralizing antibodies (bnAbs).
PGT121 is the first glycan-dependent antibody that binds complex-type N-linked glycans on HIV.
